hypotheses.G0_additive_mask_grammar: An additive layer model reaches median held-out R2 >=0.70 and median held-out selection regret <=0.05 for finite fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.G1_pairwise_mask_grammar: A pairwise layer-interaction model reaches median held-out R2 >=0.80 and median selection regret <=0.03 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G2_pairwise_interactions_are_necessary: Pairwise terms improve median R2 by at least 0.20 over additive terms on both corpora and G1 passes.
hypotheses.G3_higher_order_or_missing_variables: Pairwise median held-out R2 is below 0.50 or 90th-percentile selection regret exceeds 0.10 on either corpus.
